snapshot.h2: How we work with restaurants in Brickell and Downtown

facts.label: Services
facts.value: Social media, websites, SEO and AEO, ads

paragraphsHtml: Our team is based in Miami, and our crew comes to your restaurant for every shoot. One shoot typically produces 4 to 6 weeks of content, which we post on your pages and manage for you. Your website, Google Business Profile and ads can run through the same team.

Shimuja Ramen serves at Julia & Henry's, 200 E Flagler St, and ran a pop-up at Baby Jane in Brickell before that. We've handled its social media for about four years, by Chef Kei's count, with short videos that put the ramen first. Chef Kei talks about working with us in the video at the top of this page.

proof.h2: Google Ads for Rusty Pelican on Key Biscayne
proof.bodyHtml: We run Google Ads for Rusty Pelican Miami and built its website. In 2025, every $1 of ads brought back about $7 in conversion value tracked by Google, $135K for the year. Mother's Day alone brought 155 conversions at $3.06 each.

steps.h2: How we'd get started in Brickell and Downtown

items.title: Start with a free strategy call
items.bodyHtml: It's 30 minutes with Juan, our co-founder, not a sales rep. He goes over your Google Business Profile, website and social pages and tells you what he would start with.

items.title: Film at your restaurant
items.bodyHtml: Our crew comes in on a day you pick and films the dishes and drinks you want to feature on social media.

items.title: Post, update and report
items.bodyHtml: We post and manage your pages and keep your Google profile current. If you want ads, we set up Google and Meta ads with tracking on calls and reservations. Every month you get a report.

pricingHtml: Most restaurants invest $1,500 to $5,000 a month for a coordinated program. Website builds are a one-time $1,500 or $2,000.

faqs.q: Do you work with restaurants in Brickell and Downtown Miami?
faqs.a: Yes. We're headquartered in Miami and work with restaurants here in person. One of our clients, Shimuja Ramen, serves at Julia & Henry's on E Flagler St.

faqs.q: Will your team come to my restaurant to film?
faqs.a: Yes. We film at your restaurant on a day that works for you. One shoot typically produces 4 to 6 weeks of content.

faqs.q: Do you run Google Ads for restaurants?
faqs.a: Yes. For Rusty Pelican Miami on Key Biscayne, our 2025 Google Ads work brought back about $7 in tracked conversion value for every $1 spent, across 1,007 conversions.

faqs.q: Do you require a long-term contract?
faqs.a: No. We don't require long-term contracts. You can start with one service and add more later.

cta.h2: Let's talk about your Brickell or Downtown restaurant
cta.body: Juan will look at how your restaurant shows up on Google, on your website and on social media, and tell you what he would do first. The call is free and takes 30 minutes.
